reasoning_content: Confirmed in dmesg: the app build process was OOM-killed. The app dev server is currently restarting (pid 109222). The cms and boards dev servers are running. Let me wait until the app build finishes (the app build is now cached thanks to the previous run, so it should finish relatively quickly).

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:38489/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "app UP at check $i"; break; }
  sleep 50
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "app direct: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:38489/ 2>/dev/null
curl -sS -o /dev/null --max-time 10 -w "app via proxy: %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:80/" -H "Host: app.workspace.localhost" 2>/dev/null
free -m | sed -n '2p'

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "for i in $(seq 1 10); do

  sleep 50
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "app direct: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:38489/ 2>/dev/null
curl -sS -o /dev/null --max-time 10 -w "app via proxy: %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:80/" -H "Host: app.workspace.localhost" 2>/dev/null
free -m | sed -n '2p'", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Wait for app dev server to recover"}
